record.issue_text: P2: totalPages in admin-group.js.es6 uses Math.floor(count/limit)+1, producing a phantom empty page when user_count is an exact multiple of limit; should use Math.ceil — also makes showingLast wrong so 'next' stays enabled and leads to a blank member list

adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1`. When `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (e.g., 100/50), this yields an extra page (3 instead of 2). Because `showingLast` compares `currentPage` to this inflated `totalPages`, the UI will consider the true last page not-last, leaving “next” enabled. Clicking “next” sets `offset` to `Math.min(offset + limit, user_count)`, which can become exactly `user_count`, and `findMembers()` then requests that offset, producing an empty `members` list (blank page). Using `Math.ceil(user_count / limit)` (with appropriate zero handling) would avoid the phantom page.
